verdict.rationale: Activepieces ships self-host installers (docker-compose, curl script) and a local piece-building workflow with fast reload (see changes in 7s), which could support local/dev testing; API keys also allow programmatic triggering for CI. However, a hands-on community report explicitly found the docker-compose setup does not run local code (only pulls published images) and that dev setup instructions were missing/buggy, directly contradicting the docs' implied 'run locally for development' experience.
